get.description: Retrieve a user's profile and settings. Pass `@me` as the UUID to fetch the authenticated user; non-staff callers may only access their own account.

This endpoint is meant for reading and deleting persons. To create or update persons, we recommend using the [capture API](https://posthog.com/docs/api/capture), the `$set` and `$unset` [properties](https://posthog.com/docs/product-analytics/user-properties), or one of our SDKs.

parameters.name: client_query_id
parameters.description: Names the ClickHouse query this request runs. Send the same id to `DELETE /api/projects/:project_id/query/:client_query_id/` to stop a search that is still running. Up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: distinct_id
parameters.description: Filter list by distinct id.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter persons by email (exact match)

parameters.name: include_matched_fields
parameters.description: Tag each search result with `matched_fields`, the searched fields the term was found in. A complete email address that exactly matches a distinct ID then returns that person first, followed by every person whose email or name property contains the address.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Filter Persons by person properties.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search persons by email, name, person ID, or distinct ID. Partial values match. When the term is a complete email address or UUID that exactly matches a distinct ID or person ID, only that person is returned.

parameters.name: basic
parameters.description: Return basic insight metadata only (no results, faster).

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of user IDs. Only returns insights whose `created_by` is in the list, e.g. `[1,42]`.

parameters.name: created_date_from
parameters.description: Filter by `created_at > created_date_from`. Accepts absolute or relative dates.

parameters.name: created_date_to
parameters.description: Filter by `created_at < created_date_to`. Accepts absolute or relative dates.

parameters.name: dashboards
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of dashboard IDs. Returns insights attached to every listed dashboard (AND).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Filter by `last_modified_at > date_from`. Accepts absolute dates (`2025-04-23`) or relative strings (`-7d`, `-1m`).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Filter by `last_modified_at < date_to`. Accepts absolute dates or relative strings.

parameters.name: display
parameters.description: Comma-separated chart types, e.g. `ActionsLineGraph,ActionsBar`. Only returns trends and SQL insights shown as one of them. A trends insight with no chart type set counts as `ActionsLineGraph`.

parameters.name: exclude_bi
parameters.description: Exclude Business intelligence worksheets from the insight list.

parameters.name: favorited
parameters.description: Include this parameter (any value) to restrict results to insights marked as favorited.

parameters.name: include_dashboards
parameters.description: Opt in to receiving the deprecated `dashboards` field in insight payloads. Once opt-in enforcement is enabled, API-token callers stop receiving it by default; use `dashboard_tiles` instead.

parameters.name: insight
parameters.description: Restrict to a single insight type. `JSON` matches non-wrapper query insights; `SQL` matches HogQL queries; `BI` matches editable worksheets.

parameters.name: last_viewed_date_from
parameters.description: Filter by `last_viewed_at > last_viewed_date_from`. Accepts absolute or relative dates.

parameters.name: last_viewed_date_to
parameters.description: Filter by `last_viewed_at < last_viewed_date_to`. Accepts absolute or relative dates.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by an insight field, with a leading minus for descending order. Supports last_modified_at and last_viewed_at.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description:
Whether to refresh the retrieved insights, how aggressively, and if sync or async:
- `'force_cache'` - return cached data or a cache miss; always completes immediately as it never calculates
- `'blocking'` - calculate synchronously (returning only when the query is done), UNLESS there are very fresh results in the cache
- `'async'` - kick off background calculation (returning immediately with a query status), UNLESS there are very fresh results in the cache
- `'lazy_async'` - kick off background calculation, UNLESS there are somewhat fresh results in the cache
- `'force_blocking'` - calculate synchronously, even if fresh results are already cached
- `'force_async'` - kick off background calculation, even if fresh results are already cached
Background calculation can be tracked using the `query_status` response field.

parameters.name: saved
parameters.description: When truthy, restricts results to insights that are saved (or attached to a visible dashboard). When falsy, only unsaved insights.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term matched across name, derived_name, description, and tag names. Returns exact (case-insensitive substring) matches only; if no exact match exists, returns similar (fuzzy trigram) matches instead. Each result's `search_match_type` is `exact` or `similar`.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of tag names. Returns insights with any of the listed tags.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Include this parameter (any value) to restrict results to insights created by the authenticated user.

negatedPersonFiltersNotIn.description: Replace negated person-property filters in the WHERE of an `events` query (such as `email not_icontains`) with `person_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM persons WHERE <the filters fail>)`, so the query no longer joins every person. Applies only when every filtered person property has a materialized column, nothing else in the query reads that persons join, and the join would be a LEFT JOIN.
negatedPersonFiltersNotIn.title: Negatedpersonfiltersnotin

parserMode.description: HogQL parser backend; absent → `rust_py_with_cpp_shadow` (rust-py is primary, cpp runs as a sampled shadow). `*_shadow` modes return the primary result and sample-compare against the other parser, reporting divergences without failing the request. The `rust_py_*` modes drive the same hand-rolled Rust parser as `rust_*` but build `posthog.hogql.ast` dataclass instances directly via PyO3, skipping the JSON round-trip.

personIdPushdown.description: Push an `id IN (SELECT person_id FROM <left table> WHERE …)` predicate into the joined persons subquery, so the latest-version lookup only reads persons that the outer query's left-table filters can reach. Applies only to a persons join from the query's own FROM table. Unset, it applies to a persons join from `posthog.flag_evaluations` or from the union of events and flag_evaluations, and to no other join.
personIdPushdown.title: Personidpushdown

sessionIdPushdown.description: Push a `session_id_v7 IN (SELECT … FROM events WHERE …)` predicate into the raw_sessions subquery to limit aggregation to sessions that participate in the outer events filter.
sessionIdPushdown.title: Sessionidpushdown

sessionPropertyPreAggregation.description: Pre-filter raw_sessions aggregation by `session_id_v7 IN (cheap pre-aggregation that only materializes the columns referenced by the outer-WHERE session predicate)`. Useful when the breakdown/SELECT pulls in many session columns (e.g. `$channel_type`) but the filter only references one (e.g. `$entry_current_url`).
sessionPropertyPreAggregation.title: Sessionpropertypreaggregation

sessionTimestampBufferMinutes.description: Padding, in minutes, on each side of the event time range when it filters the sessions table by session start. Defaults to 3 days. It can only narrow the range: values above the default are ignored. Lower it only for a query that keeps just the sessions that start inside its own time range.
sessionTimestampBufferMinutes.title: Sessiontimestampbufferminutes

typeAwareCastSimplification.description: Remove provably redundant casts and nullability wrappers (e.g. `toString(String)`, `assumeNotNull(non_nullable)`, dead `ifNull` fallbacks) using inferred expression types

actions.description: The actions that fix the problem, in order of preference.

check.description: The key of the check in `health_checks` that reported the finding. Missing on an answer cached before the field existed.

code.description: Stable identifier of the problem. Each code has one meaning across every surface that reports it.

detail.description: What is wrong, what it does to the experiment, and how to fix it.
detail.title: Detail

diagnostic_ref.description: The id of the matching diagnostic in the diagnosing-experiment-health skill, for example 'A2'. Null when the skill has none.
diagnostic_ref.title: Diagnostic Ref

evidence.description: The values behind the finding, such as the p-value of the sample ratio test. The keys depend on the code.
evidence.title: Evidence

reason.description: A stable qualifier below the subcode, for example where a sample ratio mismatch is located. Null when the finding names none.
reason.title: Reason

severity.description: How much the problem affects the results: critical, warning, or info.

subcode.description: The case within the code, when a code covers several. Null when the code has one case.
subcode.title: Subcode

description.description: What the check looks for and why it matters. Missing on an answer cached before the field existed.
description.title: Description

name.description: The problem the check looks for, as the health panel lists it.
name.title: Name

reason.description: Why the check did not look, for the statuses not_applicable and not_checked, for example 'Runs after launch'. Null for passed and finding.
reason.title: Reason

rule.description: How the check decides, the same for every experiment. Null for a check without a numeric rule. Missing on an answer cached before the field existed.

status.description: passed: no problem found. finding: a finding in `health_findings`. not_applicable: the check doesn't cover the experiment's state. not_checked: an input was missing or the check failed.

values.description: What the check read on the experiment, for every status. The suffix of a key gives the unit: _count is a count, _percentage is on the 0-100 scale, _hours is hours. A key without a suffix is a setting. Missing on an answer cached before the field existed.
values.title: Values

minimum.description: What the check needs before it judges. Null when the check judges from the first value.

test.description: The statistical test that computes the value. Null for a count or a share.
test.title: Test

threshold.description: The threshold, in the unit that the suffix of the key gives.
threshold.title: Threshold

value.description: The key in `values` that the check compares with the threshold.

warns.description: above: the check reports a finding when the value is above the threshold. below: when the value is below it. A value at the threshold passes.

threshold.description: The value that the key must reach. Below it, the check reports no finding.
threshold.title: Threshold

value.description: The key in `values` that must reach the threshold before the check judges.

Submit a JSON string representing a query for PostHog data analysis, for example a HogQL query.

Example payload:

```

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "select * from events limit 100"}}

```

For more details on HogQL queries, see the [PostHog HogQL documentation](/docs/hogql#api-access).
query.title: Query

refresh.description:
Whether results should be calculated sync or async, and how much to rely on the cache:
- `'blocking'` - calculate synchronously (returning only when the query is done), UNLESS there are very fresh results in the cache
- `'async'` - kick off background calculation (returning immediately with a query status), UNLESS there are very fresh results in the cache
- `'lazy_async'` - kick off background calculation, UNLESS there are somewhat fresh results in the cache
- `'force_blocking'` - calculate synchronously, even if fresh results are already cached
- `'force_async'` - kick off background calculation, even if fresh results are already cached
- `'force_cache'` - return cached data or a cache miss; always completes immediately as it never calculates Background calculation can be tracked using the `query_status` response field.

aggregationAxisFormat.description:
Y-axis value formatter. Picks a human-friendly unit per value at render time without changing the underlying series values.

- `numeric` (default): raw numbers, e.g. `1,234`.
- `duration`: values are in seconds; rendered as friendly units per value (`45s`, `2m 12s`, `1h 4m`). Use this whenever the series is in seconds (latency, session length, time-to-event) instead of dividing in `formula` to force minutes or hours.
- `duration_ms`: values are in milliseconds; rendered as friendly units (`850ms`, `1.5s`, `1m 4s`).
- `percentage`: values are already in the 0-100 range; appends `%`.
- `percentage_scaled`: values are a 0-1 ratio; multiplied and rendered as `%`.
- `currency`: values are in the project's base currency (set in project settings, defaults to USD); rendered with that currency symbol. For values pinned to a specific currency regardless of project base (e.g. `$ai_total_cost_usd` is always USD), use `aggregationAxisPrefix` instead.
- `short`: compact notation for large counts (`1.2K`, `3.4M`).

aggregationAxisPostfix.description: Literal suffix applied to every value (e.g. ` req`). Reserve for units that `aggregationAxisFormat` cannot express. Do not use ` mins`, ` s`, ` ms`, `%` etc. — pick the matching `aggregationAxisFormat` instead so the underlying values stay numerically correct for breakdowns, formulas, and alerts. Include any leading space yourself.
aggregationAxisPostfix.title: Aggregationaxispostfix

aggregationAxisPrefix.description: Literal prefix applied to every value (e.g. `$`). Use to pin a unit or currency symbol that does not depend on `aggregationAxisFormat` — for example, when values are denominated in a fixed currency regardless of the project's base currency. Include any trailing space yourself.
aggregationAxisPrefix.title: Aggregationaxisprefix

counts_as_customer.description: Marks this goal as customer-defining: a conversion here means the person became a customer (e.g. a payment or subscription), not an intermediate step like a sign up. It gates customer-based metrics such as CAC, whose denominator is this goal's conversions — its count, or its unique converters under dau math. That equals new customers only for a once-per-person moment: a repeatable event such as a monthly payment counts every time and understates cost per customer, and dedup under dau is per result row, so someone converting under two sources counts twice at channel level. Defaults to false.
counts_as_customer.title: Counts As Customer

counts_as_revenue.description: Marks this goal as revenue-bearing: the value of a conversion is a monetary amount, not a count or an arbitrary numeric property. It gates revenue metrics such as ROAS and LTV:CAC. The amount itself comes from math_property, and its currency from math_property_revenue_currency, the same shape Revenue analytics uses for revenue events. Independent of counts_as_customer: a purchase is usually both, a trial signup neither. Defaults to false.
counts_as_revenue.title: Counts As Revenue

fixedProperties.title: Fixedproperties

excludeFromTotal.description: Keep this series out of the tooltip's total row, e.g. a target line over stacked bars.
excludeFromTotal.title: Excludefromtotal

valueLabels.description: Overrides the chart's "Show values on series" for this series. Unset or 'auto' follows the chart setting.

catalogMetric.description: Catalog provenance only: the snapshot does not track subsequent definition edits.
catalogMetric.title: Catalogmetric

catalogMetricContext.description: Catalog metadata at copy time, not a live approval of the worksheet.

comparisonPeriod.description: Explore only the comparison window, using dateRange as its reference window.

dateField.description: Column that receives the worksheet and dashboard date range.

hierarchies.description: Named dimension sequences saved with the worksheet; imports are independent copies.
hierarchies.title: Hierarchies

localFields.description: Reusable expressions owned by this worksheet only.
localFields.title: Localfields

missingDates.description: Fill missing date buckets before table calculations. Unset preserves observed points only.

panes.description: Split the returned groups into charts using these ordered dimension IDs.

querySnapshot.description: Executable catalog query snapshot. Dates and grouping belong to the definition, not the shelves.

sort.description: null sorts automatically: newest date or highest value first, so top rows survive the LIMIT.

shelf.description: Measures in older worksheets belong to rows.

computeUsing.description: Dimension ID to traverse. Unset chooses the date dimension; 'table' traverses all dimensions.
computeUsing.title: Computeusing

requireFullWindow.description: Require a complete window of non-null values before displaying a moving average.
requireFullWindow.title: Requirefullwindow

window.description: Number of points, including the current point, in a trailing moving average.
window.title: Window

fields.description: Ordered dimension IDs used to split returned groups into separate charts.
fields.title: Fields

independentAxes.description: Use a separate value scale for each pane instead of a shared primary scale.
independentAxes.title: Independentaxes

referenceLines.description: Calculate reference lines from each pane or from all returned worksheet marks.

levels.description: Ordered from the broadest dimension to the most detailed.
levels.title: Levels

annotationsScope.description: Shows only the annotations saved at this level. Unset shows every level.

chartStyle.description: Chart rendering style overrides (line shape). Only applies to line and area charts.

legendPosition.description: Where the legend sits relative to the chart. Unset falls back per chart type: right for pie and donut, bottom for proportion bar, top for the rest.

resultCustomizations.description: Per-breakdown-value color customizations. Keyed by the raw breakdown column value.
resultCustomizations.title: Resultcustomizations

stackBars100.description: Whether we fill the bars to 100% in stacked mode
stackBars100.title: Stackbars100

yAxisAtZero.description: Deprecated: use `[left|right]YAxisSettings`. Whether the Y axis should start at zero
yAxisAtZero.title: Yaxisatzero

showBestFit.description: Whether to draw a least-squares fit line through each series' points.
showBestFit.title: Showbestfit

xScale.description: X-axis scale. A `logarithmic` axis can't place a non-positive value, so those points are dropped.

xStartAtZero.description: Whether the X axis should start at zero. Off by default, because pinning either axis of two independent measures to zero squashes the correlation into a corner.
xStartAtZero.title: Xstartatzero

showTotal.description: Whether to show the aggregation total. Defaults to on only when slices show values.
showTotal.title: Showtotal

sliceContent.description: What to render on each slice. Defaults to values.

valueDisplay.description: Whether slice values show as absolute amounts or shares of the total. Only applies when `sliceContent` is `values`.

changeDecreaseColor.description: Change pill color when the series went down. Defaults to red.
changeDecreaseColor.title: Changedecreasecolor

changeIncreaseColor.description: Change pill color when the series went up. Defaults to green.
changeIncreaseColor.title: Changeincreasecolor

colorByDirection.description: Color the sparkline by whether the series went up or down.
colorByDirection.title: Colorbydirection

lineDecreaseColor.description: Sparkline color when the series went down. Defaults to red.
lineDecreaseColor.title: Linedecreasecolor

lineIncreaseColor.description: Sparkline color when the series went up. Defaults to green.
lineIncreaseColor.title: Lineincreasecolor

showChange.description: Show the change pill comparing the first point to the latest point.
showChange.title: Showchange

summary.description: Which value the resting headline shows: the latest point, the total, or the average of the returned points.

startAtZero.description: Whether the Y axis should start at zero
startAtZero.title: Startatzero

Insight.description: Simplified serializer to speed response times when loading large amounts of objects.

dashboards.description:
DEPRECATED. Will be removed in a future release. Use dashboard_tiles instead.
        A dashboard ID for each of the dashboards that this insight is displayed on.
        This field is omitted from session-authenticated responses unless `include_dashboards=true`
        is passed. Once opt-in enforcement is enabled, API-token callers (personal API keys, OAuth)
        must opt in the same way. Do not rely on it being present.

dashboard_tiles.description: A dashboard tile ID and dashboard_id for each of the dashboards that this insight is displayed on.

last_refresh.description:
The datetime this insight's results were generated.
    If added to one or more dashboards the insight can be refreshed separately on each.
    Returns the appropriate last_refresh datetime for the context the insight is viewed in
    (see from_dashboard query parameter).

cache_target_age.description: The target age of the cached results for this insight.

next_allowed_client_refresh.description:
The earliest possible datetime at which we'll allow the cached results for this insight to be refreshed
    by querying the database.

user_access_level.description: The effective access level the user has for this object

timezone.description: The timezone this chart is displayed in.

resolved_date_range.description: The period that this insight's query covered, with both ends resolved to timestamps. Null when the insight has no result yet or its query type does not report the range.

resolved_compare_date_range.description: The earlier period that this insight's query compared against, with both ends resolved to timestamps. Null when comparison is off, when the insight has no result yet, or when its query type does not report the range.

action_names.description: The name of each action the insight's series reference, keyed by action id. A series saved without a name displays this name.

query_scan.description: What ClickHouse read for this insight's last slow run, with the findings of its query scan.

warnings.description: Warnings from the run that produced these results. A `warehouse_sync` warning means the query read a data warehouse table whose sync failed, is paused, or is overdue, so the results can be out of date. Reflects the sync state when the results were computed. Null for shared insights.

filter_override_context.description: Resolved dashboard and tile filter layers used to explain filter precedence in the UI.

search_match_type.description: How this row matched the `search` query parameter: `exact` (the term is a case-insensitive substring of a searched field) or `similar` (a fuzzy trigram match, returned only when no exact match exists). Null when the list is not filtered by `search`.

dashboard.description: Dashboard filters that remain active after applying tile precedence.

tile.description: Tile filters applied above the dashboard filters.

overridden_dashboard.description: Dashboard filters replaced by the tile filters.

ignoreDashboardFilters.description: When true, this tile ignores every dashboard-level filter; the tile's own overrides still apply.

notification_settings.description: Map of notification preferences. Keys include `plugin_disabled`, `all_weekly_report_disabled`, `project_weekly_digest_disabled`, `error_tracking_weekly_digest_project_enabled`, `web_analytics_weekly_digest_project_enabled`, `organization_member_join_email_disabled`, `data_pipeline_error_threshold` (number between 0.0 and 1.0), and other per-topic switches. Values are either booleans, or (for per-project/per-resource keys) a map of IDs to booleans. Only the keys you send are updated — other preferences stay as-is.

notification_locks.description: Notification settings an organization admin enforces on this user. The matching controls are read-only, and `notification_settings` still holds the user's own choice underneath. Read-only.

anonymize_data.description: Whether PostHog should anonymize events captured for this user when identified.

is_staff.title: Staff status
is_staff.description: Designates whether the user can log into this admin site.

is_impersonated_reason.description: The reason the operator gave when the current impersonation session started (or was last up/downgraded). Null when not impersonating.

fresh_reauth_expires_at.description: When the last re-authentication stops counting as fresh. Changing `email` after this needs a new re-authentication. Null when the session has none on record.

current_password.description: The user's current password. Required when changing `password` if the user already has a usable password set.

passkeys_enabled_for_2fa.description: Whether passkeys are enabled for 2FA authentication. Users can disable this to use only TOTP for 2FA while keeping passkeys for login.

hide_mcp_hints.description: When true, the user has opted out of in-app hints promoting the PostHog MCP integration after taking actions.

ui_configuration.description: Per-user UI customization, validated against the `UserUIConfiguration` schema. Covers SQL editor settings such as Vim mode and the vimrc. Send the complete object: it replaces the stored value wholesale. Null means no customization.

onboarding_delegated_to_organization_id.description: Organization ID of the pending delegation invite, if any. Used by the frontend to scope the 'waiting for teammate' UI to the org where delegation was initiated.

active_realtime_notification_types.description: Real-time notification types that currently have a live dispatch site. Drives the in-app notifications settings UI. Read-only.

requires_credential_review.description: True if the user belongs to an organization that a partner provisioned, has not yet acknowledged the access on their account, and has at least one Personal API Key or passkey, or a third-party OAuth application that can currently act as them. Used to gate a one-shot review screen on first post-provisioning login. Becomes False once the user POSTs to `/api/users/@me/credentials_review_complete/`. Read-only.

personal_api_keys_limit.description: How many personal API keys the user may hold, from the `personal_api_keys` billing entitlement of the user's organizations. The highest limit across their organizations applies, and 10 when no organization grants a limit. Creating a key beyond it is rejected with a validation error. Read-only.

is_not_active_reason.title: De-activated reason
is_not_active_reason.description: (optional) reason for why the organization has been de-activated. This will be displayed to users on the web app.

is_pending_deletion.description: Set to True when org deletion has been initiated. Blocks all UI access until the async task completes.

membership_joined_at.description: When the requesting user joined this organization. Null if the user is not a member.

is_member_join_email_enabled.description: Legacy field; member-join emails are controlled per user in account notification settings.

enforce_verified_domains.description: When True, logins, signups, and invites for this organization are restricted to email addresses on its verified domains.

members_can_create_projects.description: When True, organization members (below admin) are allowed to create new projects. Admins and owners can always create projects.

members_can_see_org_members.description: When False, members (below admin) only see themselves in the members list and only project members in access control.

read_only_mcp_access.description: When True, requests through the PostHog MCP server can read but not change this organization's data.

member_notice.description: Notice shown in a banner to every member of the organization. Set to null to remove it.

is_ai_training_opted_in.description: When True, this organization allows its data to be used to train PostHog AI models.

is_ai_training_locked.description: When True, the AI training opt-out setting cannot be modified through the UI or API.

is_ai_training_cta_shown.description: When True, in-app callouts inviting members to enable AI training are shown.

has_signed_baa.description: Whether the organization has a countersigned Business Associate Agreement on file. When true, AI training stays opted out and cannot be changed.

default_anonymize_ips.description: Default setting for 'Discard client IP data' for new projects in this organization.

default_role_id.description: ID of the role to automatically assign to new members joining the organization

is_active.title: Active
is_active.description: Set this to 'No' to temporarily disable an organization.

is_not_active_reason.title: De-activated reason
is_not_active_reason.description: (optional) reason for why the organization has been de-activated. This will be displayed to users on the web app.

is_pending_deletion.description: Set to True when org deletion has been initiated. Blocks all UI access until the async task completes.

uses_most_specific_access_resolution.description: When True, access controls resolve with the most specific matching rule. When False, the legacy resolution order applies.

ip_restrictions.description: IP addresses and CIDR blocks allowed to access this organization. Empty means every IP is allowed.

ip_restrictions_enabled.description: When False, the IP allowlist is kept but not enforced.

ip_restrictions_warning.description: A warning when the current request's IP address is not in the saved allowlist.
